name: Zscaler — Malicious Web Content Blocked (Post-Phishing)
xql_query:
dataset = zscaler_nssweblog_raw
| filter act = "Blocked"
| filter cs1 = "Malicious Content"
       or cat contains "Spyware" or cat contains "Malware" or cat contains "Phishing"
       or cat contains "Adware" or cat contains "Botnet" or cat contains "Exploit"
| filter src != null and suser != null
| alter src_ip = src, user_name = suser, url = request, dst_ip = dst
description: Zscaler NSS web log Blocked action on malicious web content (Malicious Content / Malware / Spyware / Phishing / Adware / Botnet category) — victim browser reached the payload host after the phishing click. Correlated to the victim by src IP and suser.
alert_description:
What fired: Zscaler NSS web log Blocked action on malicious web content (Malicious Content / Malware / Spyware / Phishing / Adware / Botnet category) — victim browser reached the payload host after the phishing click. Correlated to the victim by src IP and suser.

Why it matters: a host is communicating with known-bad or anomalous infrastructure (C2 / malicious domain). Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols (TA0011 - Command and Control).

Investigate:
  - Identify the internal client and the domain/IP contacted, and check reputation + resolution history.
  - Look for the initial delivery vector (email/web/download) and any beaconing cadence or follow-on payloads from the same host.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0011 - Command and Control: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
